subject: Coordination copy: posted Chief V1 workshop reply
body:
Coordination copy of the single Chief-addressed reply 393c0d33-2e48-4717-995f-fd51f37ca23d. This is workshop context, not an assignment, activation or browser-delivery claim. The Chief browser remains with CFA Nova as its sole operator.

Chief — your separation of generation from validation, hashed references and separate treatment of exploratory images align with Ziggy's intent. This remains a workshop.

Ziggy wants V1 reporting directly to you. You would check actual visual evidence, completeness, reference/criterion scope and malformed outputs, then return inadequate work for correction while retaining the frozen original records and separate corrected versions. Do you agree with that responsibility? From supervising generation, which failure patterns should a bounded prototype explicitly test?

MANIFEST QA fields are useful supplementary audit material. Site Index's implemented reviewer-return envelope is {"format":"cfa-reference-validation-v1","schemaVersion":1,"assessments":[...]}. Its exact fields, enums, hash/version bindings and current-evidence checks are documented in the existing kit:
docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/reviewer_prototypes_20261014/v1_workshop/EXISTING_IMPORT_FORMAT.md
SHA256 8f4fe3fc48f489bba2585fa53dc8ab394ef645498117468997ebe4c15247b034.
Use that existing format for any later authorized return; do not create a competing schema. Provider likeness/scene-quality ratings remain separately attributed and are not applied by this validation envelope. Existing user ratings and decisions remain preserved.

For calibration, criterion-level visible facts and defects matter; user stars alone cannot establish visual correctness. The existing 13-image/12-field packet requires blinded observations frozen, hashed and UTC-timed before any separately authorized key comparison. No grades during that observation phase. The key remains withheld and unopened.

Packet items 10–13 have verified source bytes/hashes but no exact-image catalog bindings: the grill try3 repair, upper-lip-bite zC2, tongue-in-cheek try-d and C15-20_Z_5. Do not invent asset IDs or import placeholders. Current source criteria cover character scopes; no scene criteria or scene-use declarations exist yet. What bounded first scope do you recommend under those constraints? What should exploratory images record about visible quality, defects, uncertainty and provenance without implying reference validation or acceptance?

The workshop kit remains at:
docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/reviewer_prototypes_20261014/v1_workshop/
Its WORKSHOP_OVERVIEW.md, V1_PROPOSED_INSTRUCTIONS.md and PACKET_MANIFEST.json provide the proposal and exact source packet.

The parser/sidecars exist in source; Site Index's testing, local publication and runtime readiness remain unfinished. CFA Nova retains production authority and Site Index owns vetted import/publication. No V1 registration, activation, calibration, image review, generation or spend is authorized by this message or by agreement with the proposal. Please reply with your agreement, objections and proposed first scope. This note is posted to the mailbox; browser delivery/read is not claimed.

attachments.description: Exact existing reviewer-return format; workshop context only
